note: Every reference is a still inside a presentation frame. measure.mjs read the whole image, so sizes are re-read by eye against the inner screen scaled to 1440 (by: eye). Faces: fonts.mjs found nothing close for any serif display (nearest 3 to 4.5 far); the top three were rendered with each reference's words beside it and the one plainly of its kind taken. All faces are stand-ins.

names.#be7522: the puppy's fur, raised to read as an accent (3.2:1 on the ground: large text and blocks only)

likes.what: pictures of the animal at home and outside, in window light
likes.why: the product's own subject; stand-ins until theirs

things: the animal's name, age and one line beside its pictures

references.name: 01-giant-serif-name

likes.what: the name in a huge thin serif across the whole page, with one small picture crossing it
likes.why: the name is the poster, and the picture sits on it like a print on a table

references.concept: The name is the poster. One small print sits on it, crossing the letters, as on a table.
references.move: a two-line name filling the full width, cropped at both edges, one print over its middle
references.layout: Name in two lines, 0 to 100% width (runs off both edges), lines from 27% to 74% of the height, tight leading. One print about 19% wide by 34% high, centred, over both lines, with one or two prints peeking behind it. Small sans in three places: top left (name, 5%), top at 29% (nav, stacked, underlined), top right (place and year); bottom row at 88% to 95%: a two-line note under the nav column, a circular stamp bottom right, a small mark bottom left. 88% empty ground.
references.spacing: Margin 72 px at 1440. Nav lines 14 px apart, groups 28. Note lines sit 6 px under each other.
references.pictures: One small print, as shot (colour), no border, crossing the name; a second and third peek out behind it, offset a few px.
devices: underlined nav links stacked in one column
a circular ring of small text as a stamp

references.name: 02-split-story

likes.what: a short story in serif on a warm panel, beside a big close photo
likes.why: it reads like the first page of a book

references.concept: A book spread: the left page tells, the right page shows one face close.
references.move: a centred serif story on a tan panel facing a full-bleed close portrait
references.layout: Two halves: left 47% a tan panel; right 53% a full-bleed close photo. Story centred in the panel, 5 to 6 short lines, top 10% to 47%; a small photo 28% of the panel wide under it, centred; a tiny uppercase quote at the bottom, and a down arrow bottom left. On the photo: the name in white serif, two lines, bottom right at 60% to 97%. Tiny uppercase nav at the top right over the photo; a small mark top left.

display.italic: one or two words in italic

references.spacing: Panel padding about 80 px; story lines touch (leading 1.05); 36 px from story to small photo.
references.pictures: One big close crop, full bleed, as shot, warm; one small framed copy on the panel.
devices: italic words inside the serif story

references.name: 03-name-over-strip

likes.what: the name centred in serif above a row of pictures of different widths

references.concept: A gallery header: the name between two rules, the work as one row under it.
references.move: a centred two-line serif name between hairlines over a strip of mixed-width pictures
references.layout: Thin top bar with small pictures and a centred label. A hairline at 13%. Name centred, two lines, 15% to 43%, about 62% of the width. A hairline under it at 45%. Below: a column of small uppercase text left (8% to 26% of width) set in a ring, then a row of pictures of different widths from 32% to 100% (runs off the right), 49% to 85% high. Small uppercase text block under the last picture.
references.spacing: Margin 32 px; 24 px between pictures; hairlines full width inside the margin.
references.pictures: Three to four pictures as shot, no border, same height, different widths, the last running off the edge.
devices: text set in an oval ring

references.name: 04-face-and-orange

likes.what: a face filling the page with the name across it, and one orange block
likes.why: the close-up makes it personal, the orange is the only loud thing

references.concept: A face as the page; the name across it; one orange block as the only loud thing.
references.move: an extreme close-up filling 60% of the screen, a heavy serif name crossing onto a cream panel with an orange block
references.layout: Left 63%: a close crop of a face, full height. Right 37%: a cream panel, its lower 45% an orange block. Name in a heavy serif across the bottom third, from 25% to 80% of the width, crossing from the photo onto the orange (outline where it crosses). A small portrait on the panel at the seam, 15% wide. Small sans nav at the top. A thin circle drawn over the face. A small yellow tab left.
references.spacing: Margin 64 px; nav items 64 apart; the name sits 80 px above the bottom.
references.pictures: One extreme close-up, full height, as shot; one small portrait on the panel.
devices: a thin circle over the face
the name switching to outline where it crosses colour

references.name: 05-scattered-prints

likes.what: a few prints dropped at angles over a big red serif word
likes.why: playful without being cute, like photos on a desk

references.concept: Prints dropped on a desk over one big red word.
references.move: two white-bordered prints at slight angles over a giant red serif word
references.layout: Warm grey frame; a cream page inset 7% each side, 21% to 79% high. A red serif word across the page middle, running off both edges, 46% to 61% high. Two prints over it: one tall (24% wide), one smaller (19%), rotated -2 and 3 degrees, white border. Small sans in the four corners of the page (name, nav, index, scroll). Above and below the page: the name and a line, centred.
references.spacing: Page margin 28 px for corner text; prints 30 px apart.
references.pictures: Prints with a white border about 6 px, slight rotation, a faint drop under them.
devices: a frame of warm grey around the page

references.name: 06-framed-script

likes.what: one framed picture on a calm ground with a thin script line drawn through the page
likes.why: quiet, and the line leads the eye

references.concept: Quiet: one framed picture, a calm page, and a hand-drawn line that leads the eye to the words.
references.move: a single thin line looping across the page from picture to headline
references.layout: Left 50%: a picture ground with a framed picture inside it (54% of the half wide, centred). Right 50%: light grey, a thin serif uppercase headline centred at 30% to 45%, a two-line subline under it, a small picture at the bottom centre. A thin line loops from the top, behind the headline, out to the bottom. Name small, centred top of the left half; a menu icon top right; a vertical line of tiny text at the seam.
references.spacing: Headline block centred in its half; 28 px headline to subline.
references.pictures: One framed picture inside a picture ground; one small picture at the bottom.
devices: a thin hand-drawn line looping through the page
vertical tiny text at the seam

references.name: 07-name-collage

likes.what: pictures overlapping with the name set over them
likes.why: lively, a whole session at a glance

references.concept: A session at a glance: pictures overlapping, the name across them.
references.move: colour and black-and-white pictures overlapping, a high-contrast serif name set across
references.layout: Light page. Big colour picture left 40%, full height; a black-and-white picture overlapping its bottom right; another small black-and-white top right. Name across the middle from 18% to 72%, crossing picture and ground. Small text block bottom right.
references.spacing: Margin 14 px to the pictures; text block 40 px from the right.
references.pictures: Overlapping, colour and black and white mixed, a soft shadow under the small ones.
devices: a line struck through part of the name
a short dash above the text block

references.name: 08-thin-number

likes.what: thin tall type, small pictures and one big number
likes.why: airy, with a sense of order

references.concept: Airy order: hairline tall type, small pictures placed loosely, one big number.
references.move: one huge hairline number bottom right, small pictures placed on a loose grid
references.layout: Cream page. Name in a hairline tall serif top left, running off the left edge. A mid-size landscape picture in the centre overlapping the name. Two small pictures (top right, bottom left). A huge number bottom right, 30% wide. Tiny text: a short paragraph left, prev/next in the thin serif.

references.name: 09-contact-grid

likes.what: black-and-white pictures in a tight grid, like a contact sheet
likes.why: honest, it shows the work as it was shot

references.concept: A contact sheet: frames in a tight grid, black and white, shown as shot.
references.move: a tight three-column grid of black-and-white frames with no gaps
references.layout: Poster. Small colour bar and credits top left, a bold grotesk title at 23%, then a 3 by 3 grid of black-and-white frames with no gaps from 31% to 95%.
references.spacing: No gap between frames; margin 7% around.
references.pictures: Black and white, grain, no gaps, square-ish frames.
devices: a strip of five colour chips

references.name: 10-red-vertical-name

likes.what: the red name running down the side, with prints scattered beside it

references.concept: The name, turned on its side in red, frames the page; prints are scattered beside it.
references.move: a giant red serif name rotated up the left edge, three prints at angles beside it
references.layout: Warm grey frame; cream page inset 7%, 21% to 79% high. Red name rotated -90deg, 14% to 37% of the width, running off the bottom. Three white-bordered prints at angles (-30, 0, 12 degrees) from 37% to 83% of the width. Caption under the middle print. Corner labels in small sans; a thin circle with a red dot.
references.pictures: White-bordered prints at angles, a faint shadow.
devices: a thin circle with a dot
a frame of warm grey around the page
